questions.prompt: Which item is due first and which control advances it?
criteria: First due task can be identified
Action is labelled in the same task group

questions.prompt: Which concrete education context is visible without relying on the logo?
criteria: Task counts and deadlines remain connected
Daily teaching sessions are visible near the task queue

critique.hierarchy: Context leads, then grouped decision objects and a labelled primary action.
critique.typography: Google Sans Flex follows the supplied title, body and caption roles with readable Vietnamese diacritics.
critique.spacing: 20px gutters, 12px grouping and 16px card padding; floating blue navigation matches the supplied system.
critique.media: Original illustrative avatars and line icons only. Static canvas displays the canonical inert DOM with no raster artboard tiles; the explicit prototype viewer runs the source route.
critique.distinctiveness: Work counts, deadlines and teaching-session context make the education work visible.

reviewer.instruction: Show only this reviewer packet and anonymously labelled captures. Answer before seeing another candidate. Do not disclose answer criteria or author preference.

boundary: Labels do not prove blinding. A facilitator who also authored or grades the candidates must report heuristic review. Human provenance remains a reviewer declaration.
